1. Claim 281 (Currently amended)

A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising:
first and second layers;
a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer;
a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer;
__wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are configured to be cured to each other__;
the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers;
a medial section, wherein __the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer__; and
__an additional adhesive layer distinct from the first and second adhesive layers__.

2. Claim 282 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal __selected from the group consisting of steel, aluminum, and titanium__.

3. Claim 283 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure __having a density of less than 0.1 g/cm³__.

4. Claim 284 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 282, wherein the medial section is a composite material __comprising the metal and a reinforcing material__.

5. Claim 285 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

6. Claim 286 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

7. Claim 287 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 286, wherein the weld ring is continuous __and has a uniform thickness__.

8. Claim 288 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is formed from a material __different from the material of the first and second layers__.

9. Claim 289 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is segmented __into at least three discrete segments__.

10. Claim 290 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 285, further comprising an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

11. Claim 291 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

12. Claim 293 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, wherein the weld ring is continuous __and extends radially outward from the medial section__.

13. Claim 294 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring has a radial thickness __of between 2 mm and 10 mm__.

14. Claim 295 (Currently amended)

The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is segmented __into discrete segments separated by gaps of between 1 mm and 5 mm__.
